summary: Metalla Royalty & Streaming Ltd. filed a Form 6-K with condensed interim consolidated financial statements and MD&A for the quarter ended June 30, 2026, plus certifications and a press release. The filing is a routine periodic report containing financial results only, with no transaction such as M&A, tender offer, or capital return. No special-situation event is disclosed; the filing satisfies foreign private issuer reporting obligations under the Securities Exchange Act.
